name: Fullstack: Spring Boot + React
description: Spring Boot (Maven) backend + Vite/React/TypeScript frontend, wired together with a dev proxy and a shared dev script. The frontend takes the same optional add-ons as the react-ts template.

prompts.name: addons
prompts.message: Optional frontend add-ons (space to toggle, enter to confirm, none is fine)

options.label: RTK Query
options.hint: calls your Spring backend instead of plain fetch

postInstall: npm install                 # root: installs 'concurrently' for the dev script
npm run dev                 # runs backend (:8080) and frontend (:5173) together
cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev
